title: Complete Web Development Bootcamp
description: Go from zero to full-stack developer with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, and MongoDB. Build 10 real-world projects along the way and land your first dev job.
curriculum: Introduction to React and Component Architecture
Deploying Full-Stack Apps to Vercel & Railway

title: UI/UX Design Masterclass
description: Master the full UI/UX design process from research to high-fidelity prototypes. Learn Figma, design systems, and usability testing to create products users love.
curriculum: Design Thinking and the UX Process
Handoff to Developers with Figma Inspect

title: Digital Marketing & SEO Strategy
description: Build a complete digital marketing strategy covering SEO, content marketing, paid ads, email campaigns, and analytics. Drive real traffic and grow any business online.

title: Python for Data Science & Machine Learning
description: Master Python, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn, and TensorFlow. Build regression models, classifiers, and neural networks with real datasets from Kaggle.

Data Fetching with fetch, SWR and React Query

description: Learn Adobe Illustrator from scratch and create logos, illustrations, icons, and brand identity kits. Perfect for freelancers and aspiring graphic designers.
curriculum: Vector Basics: Paths, Anchors, and Bezier Curves

title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
description: Understand how hackers think and how to defend against them. Covers network security, ethical hacking basics, cryptography, phishing, and preparing for the CompTIA Security+ exam.
curriculum: Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing Intro

title: Freelancing & Personal Branding for Developers
